description: Build, break, debug and evaluate in your own environment.

lessons.title: Lab: Decompositions & multivariable calculus
lessons.conceptOverview: Compute derivatives of a two-variable quadratic and check them using finite differences. Explain what positive Hessian eigenvalues imply locally.
lessons.whyItMatters: Derive the tools behind optimization and representation.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: SVD factors a matrix into orthogonal directions and singular values. Truncated SVD gives a low-rank approximation. A Jacobian collects first derivatives of vector outputs; a Hessian contains second derivatives of a scalar. Shapes matter when composing derivatives through a neural network.

sections.title: 1. Establish a baseline
sections.content: Write down your inputs, expected behavior and constraints before starting. Compute derivatives of a two-variable quadratic and check them using finite differences. Explain what positive Hessian eigenvalues imply locally.

sections.title: 2. Introduce a failure
sections.content: Test the mistaken assumption: A Jacobian and Hessian always have the same shape. Record the observed result and the point where it diverges from your prediction.

sections.title: 3. Debug and evaluate
sections.content: Use the mechanism to explain the failure: SVD factors a matrix into orthogonal directions and singular values. Truncated SVD gives a low-rank approximation. A Jacobian collects first derivatives of vector outputs; a Hessian contains second derivatives of a scalar. Shapes matter when composing derivatives through a neural network. Change one variable at a time. Repeat the baseline and add a held-out case. Submit the implementation, results and limitations.

commonMistakes: A Jacobian and Hessian always have the same shape.
keyTakeaways: SVD factors a matrix into orthogonal directions and singular values.

lessons.title: Lab: Probability & information theory
lessons.conceptOverview: Calculate entropy for a fair and a biased binary distribution. Compare KL in both directions and handle zero probabilities explicitly.
lessons.whyItMatters: Derive the tools behind optimization and representation.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Maximum likelihood chooses parameters that make observed data probable. Negative log likelihood connects to cross entropy for categorical targets. KL divergence measures a directed discrepancy between distributions and is not symmetric. Mutual information quantifies dependence, rather than causation.

lessons.title: Lab: Optimization & numerical stability
lessons.conceptOverview: Implement stable softmax and test logits near 1000. Verify that probabilities sum to one and remain unchanged when adding the same constant to all logits.
lessons.whyItMatters: Derive the tools behind optimization and representation.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Floating-point arithmetic rounds values and can overflow or underflow. Stable softmax subtracts the maximum logit before exponentiation. Conditioning describes sensitivity to perturbations; gradient scaling does not fix ill-conditioned data. Compare optimizers using convergence and generalization, not just training loss.
